analysis:
MARKET & PORTFOLIO REVIEW: SPY regime is MIXED — price slightly below SMA50 but the 20-day slope is modestly positive (+1.21%). This is not a time to be aggressive; one disciplined addition to an existing quality setup is the right posture. Overall portfolio heat is low (1.34%) and max drawdown contained (3.81%), which is good. The Sortino of -3.66 reflects some recent stop-outs (WDAY x2, LII) and means downside vol has outpaced upside — reinforcing the need for disciplined entries.

POSITION REVIEW:
— A (+6.94%): Thesis intact; uptrend extending. ALERT: Earnings Aug 26 (26 days). Consider trimming 20-30% before the print or be prepared to hold through volatility.
— AMP (+4.58%): Not in screened list but performing fine. Monitor.
— CI (-2.89%): FLAG — CI does NOT appear in this cycle's screened candidates. This may indicate it failed the 'no confirmed downtrend' filter. The position is -2.89% from cost but the thesis warrants scrutiny. If CI continues to lag or breaks below $275, exit on thesis-break grounds even before a formal stop is hit.
— LMT (+2.40%): In screened list, uptrend extending, thesis intact.
— MCO (+2.36%): Not in screened list but performing fine. Monitor.

NEW TRADE RATIONALE: Portfolio has $28,092 headroom and is at 5 positions (upper bound of the 3-5 target). I will propose one trade only — FDS — which offers the single clearest asymmetric setup on the board. We have two prior profitable closed trades in FDS (+17.97%, +11.51%), the fundamental profile is excellent, and the technical setup is a Stage 1-to-2 basing transition with the stock in the lower 36% of its 52-week range. Forward P/E of 13.35 is compelling for a 27% ROE, 30%+ margin business. All other candidates are either too extended in range (TRV 85%, NSC 80%, IQV 89%), in mixed/sideways trends without basing clarity, or carry lower conviction on fundamentals. Cash preservation and single high-conviction addition is the correct call here.

trades.entry_strategy: Limit order at $263 or better; accept fills up to $268. On any pullback toward $255-258 (near SMA50), add aggressively within position size. Do not chase above $272 — wait for a reset.
trades.rationale: FUNDAMENTAL: FactSet is a durable, capital-light financial data business with 27% ROE, 30.5% operating margins, $621M FCF, and a forward P/E of 13.35 — exceptional value for this quality tier. PEG of 1.30 signals fair-to-undervalued pricing. Revenue growth is steady at +6.4% with analyst EPS revisions trending slightly positive. We have direct experience with this name: two prior exits at +17.97% and +11.51% confirm the thesis cycle. TECHNICAL: Stock is in the lower 36% of its 52-week range — well off the $396 high — and is in a confirmed basing/early uptrend. SMA50 slope has inflected positively at +6.0%/20d. At +7.7% above SMA50, the stock is not yet extended. ATR at 5% of price provides a healthy stop distance without being excessive. Earnings are 48 days out (Sept 17), giving adequate runway for the position to develop before the next catalyst event.
trades.exit_plan: Primary exit: price target $310 (~18% gain). Stop: $243 (hard stop, 1.52x ATR). Thesis-break conditions: (1) FDS breaks below SMA200 on volume, (2) earnings show revenue deceleration below 4% or margin compression, (3) broad financial data sector de-rating. Time stop: reassess if no progress toward target within 60 days. Pre-earnings (Sept 10): decide to hold or trim to half-size based on position P&L and market conditions — do not hold full size through earnings given the 5% ATR.
